Indian Airforce Group Y/ Medical Assistant Airmen Intake Recruitment 2026 : Vacancy Details
Post Name Eligibility Criteria
Indian Airforce Group Y/ Medical Assistant Airmen Intake
  • Medical Assistant Trade : Candidates who have passed 10+2 / Intermediate or an equivalent examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English securing at least 50% aggregate marks and 50% marks in English, or completed a two-year vocational course with non-vocational subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English) with the same minimum marks from a recognized board, are eligible for this recruitment.
  • Medical Assistant Trade (Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy) : Candidates must have passed 10+2 / Intermediate with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English securing at least 50% aggregate marks and 50% marks in English, and also possess a Diploma or B.Sc in Pharmacy with minimum 50% aggregate marks along with valid registration from the State Pharmacy Council or Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).
 Indian Airforce Group Y/ Medical Assistant Airmen Intake Recruitment : Medical Standard / PFT
    • Physical Fitness Test (PFT) :
    1. For candidates up to the age of 21 Years 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes.
    2. For candidates above 21 years of age and holding Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy – 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes 30 Seconds.
    • Height : Minimum 152.5 cms
    • Cycling – Should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 5 cms.
    • Hearing : Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
    • Weight : Proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
    • Dental : Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
    • Visual Standards : 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error Not exceeding + 3.50D including Astigmatism.
